author: Kusha N M

lines: ನಡೆವ ಹಾದಿಯ ನೋವ ಮುನ್ಸಿಗುವ ಫಲ ನೀಗೆ

raw:
ನುಡಿದಂತೆ ನಡೆಯುವುದು ಜೀವನದಿ ಬಲುಕಷ್ಟ
ಪಡೆಯುವುದೆ ಬೆಂಬಲವ ಕಠಿಣವಿಹ ದಾರಿ
ನಡೆವ ಹಾದಿಯ ನೋವ ಮುನ್ಸಿಗುವ ಫಲ ನೀಗೆ
ನಡೆನಿನದು ಸರಿಯಹುದು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: To walk as you talk is very hard in life;
getting support is itself a hard road;
when the pain of the road you walk outweighs the fruit you get first,
your walk will prove right, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Living up to our words is difficult, and support is hard to find. When we endure the pain of the path without chasing quick rewards, our conduct is vindicated.
